plan.hypothesis: Automation may reduce source-reading and manual coordination backlog and hence physical service time; strong automated conventional references may tie or win.
plan.scope: Separate internal scenario family with explicit hypothetical human-capacity parameters. It does not replace prior B5/B8 comparisons or claim empirically calibrated human productivity/errors.
plan.fairness: Identical seed, public input bytes, formal report delay, resource/fleet/field capacities, physical rules, consent and owner reviews in every arm. Human reviews share the native decision pool in ALL arms. No human task creates truth, certifies safety or authorizes aid.
plan.manualRouting: Public source ID hash assigns each manual reader to one of four owners. After a completed read, competent common interpretation triages nonactionable material without extra decision/relay work; actionable local decisions stay local, other owners relay actual completed snapshots to owner0. Integrated operational needs are handed only to foreign owners selected by the common received-data allocation preview; owned capacity requires no partner relay. These are declared workflow assumptions, not measured universal practice.
plan.failurePolicy: At most two attempts per inconclusive manual stage, with all receipts and errors retained. Missing relay, rejected work, unserved demand, unknown fees and provider failures are never counted as completed service.
plan.clocks: Publication, HTTP receipt, native human work, model availability, inquiry and physical receipt are separate source clocks. Provider measured wall time is charged at max(native model latency, measured provider duration). Host SQL/UI wall time is separately reported.
plan.coalescing: All arms recompile only after the received response material signature or eligible integrated need IDs change. Receipt ingestion, owner review, physical execution and unknown human/inquiry queues continue at each common60s pump or earlier received native readyAt; no private completion or skipped horizon. Public feed downloads occur only in the coordinator store actually consumed by this controller; distributed reading still obtains its own native authenticated source snapshot.
plan.controls: Keep zero profile, moderate, burst, B5/B8 upper bounds, failed and censored worlds. Human errors are source-seeded and apply to the same owner review mechanism for NEXO; no arm-specific random error or forced duplicate score.
plan.endpoint: First useful and sufficient physical service RMST at the fixed horizon, by native demand and resource units; background task completion or proposal approval is not aid.
plan.errorScope: Zero-error capacity study; not evidence about human mistake frequency.
plan.attribution: C_manual is a separately declared manual workflow, not a substitute for the strong existing B5/B8 references.
plan.costPolicy: Reserve each full declared paid episode cap before launch. Retain exact known cost, unknown-call reservations, every failed/censored/missing planned world. No cap raised or last episode shrunk after outcomes.
plan.stopPolicy: Honor stop/signal only at settled provider/round boundaries; source work already issued is observed to fixed horizon, with controller status stopped and demand right-censored honestly.

blocked.reason: Native owner-review lapse lifecycle must be reviewed before this sensitivity; no source changes during active studies.

scope: Root-approved staged secondary controls. No world/UI/source benchmark overlaps paid HTTP/model clocks. Preserve all losses, deficits, censored and recovered-error outcomes; no comparison to unplanned baselines or empirically calibrated human rates.
assumptions: A native relay transports one received snapshot per task; manual flow does not batch many need handoffs into one call. C_decentralized broadcasts all relevant milestones and is a secondary upper-broadcast profile, not universal conventional practice. Zero/5-second-reading/8-readers controls bound rate assumptions.
